Title: Filesystem SDKs for Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 now generally available

Body.Content:
Python, .NET, Java, and JS filesystem SDKs for Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 are now generally available in all Azure regions. These client libraries include support for CRUD operations for filesystems, directories, files, and permissions through filesystem semantics for ADLS Gen2. Customers can now use this familiar filesystem programming model to simplify application development for ADLS Gen2. These filesystem SDKs streamline our customers’ ability to ingest, manage, and analyze data for ADLS Gen2 and help them gain insights at cloud scale faster than ever before.  

Detailed documentation is available in the links below:

  • .NET SDK
  • Python SDK
  • Java SDK
  • JS SDK

Read the blog post to learn more.
